user.title: Set up Schneid MR-12
user.description:
Connect to the Schneid MR-12 district heating transfer station via Modbus TCP.

Default port: 502 | Default slave ID: 1

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the transfer station on the network.
data_description.slave_id: Modbus slave address of the controller (default: 1, configurable on the controller).
data_description.scan_interval: How often the controller should be polled (5–3600 seconds).
data_description.heating_circuits: Select which heating circuits should be visible in Home Assistant.
data_description.read_only: In read-only mode, no writable entities (Number, Select) are created.

error.cannot_connect: Connection failed. Please check the IP address, port, and network connection.

abort.already_configured: This transfer station is already configured.
